subject: general
question: The shopkeeper offers two successive discounts on a machine that is marked at ₹18,000 so that its selling price gets reduced to ₹12,960. If 10% and x % are the respective discounts, the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total discount multiplier = 12960 ÷ 18000 = 0.72

First discount multiplier (10%) = 0.90

Second discount multiplier (x) = 0.72 ÷ 0.90 = 0.80

Discount percentage **x** = (1 − 0.80) × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price (MP)** = ₹18,000

**First Discount** = 10%

**Final Selling Price (SP)** = ₹12,960

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b34c6bef267062846b1e4f23e764797bf8d62b6f7d551c797528c9f2c83612f.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Price after discount = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 10% discount = 18,000 × (90/100)

⇒ Intermediate Price = 18,000 × 0.9 = ₹16,200

⇒ Now, SP = Intermediate Price × (100 − x)/100

⇒ 12,960 = 16,200 × (100 − x)/100

⇒ 12,960 ÷ 16,200 = (100 − x)/100

⇒ 1296 ÷ 1620 = (100 − x)/100

⇒ 0.8 = (100 − x)/100

⇒ 80 = 100 − x

⇒ x = 100 − 80 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

A single equivalent discount for two successive discounts a% and b% is given by: (a + b − ab/100)%.

Marked Price and Selling Price

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) ... × (1 − dₙ/100).

Discount vs. Profit

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**, whereas Profit or Loss is calculated on the **Cost Price (CP)**.
